ftl_title: XML files to download for FencingTimeLive
ftl_intro: The files are built at the moment you download them, from the entry list as it stands then — nothing here is prepared in advance. Download them again on the morning of the event; the list can still change until then.
ftl_empty: Nobody has entered this event yet, so there is nothing to download.
ftl_import_picklist: Do NOT import as a competition — it is a pick-list, step 6
ftl_howto_lead: Menu paths are given as they appear in Fencing Time. Page numbers refer to the Fencing Time 4.7 User's Guide.
ftl_step1_h: Download the files and unzip them
ftl_step1_b: Click “Download everything (.zip)” and unzip it on the machine that runs Fencing Time. A single file can be taken with the button in its own row.
ftl_step2_b: File → Import → Import Events (p. 22). Choose the file, check the weapon, gender and age category on the preview, then click Import. Start with the POOLS-MIXED files — one per weapon — and only then import the DE files.
ftl_step3_h: Combine the elimination tables if you prefer
ftl_step3_b: The DE files are split as finely as possible: one table per gender and category. Some hold one or two fencers, and that is intended. Combine them freely: Combine Events (p. 22). We re-split the results by birth year regardless, so your combining costs us nothing. We only ask that you do not rename an event to a category it does not contain.
ftl_step4_h: Do not remove the digit from the surname
ftl_step4_b: “PRZYKŁADOWSKA (1) Anna” means category V1. That digit is how we read the results back into the ranking. A surname without it reaches us with no category and has to be fixed by hand.
ftl_step5_h: Refresh the entry list on the morning of the event
ftl_step5_b: Download the files again, then in Fencing Time open the Summary tab and choose Re-Import Competitors from XML File (p. 144). Rounds already fenced and scores already entered stay where they are — only the list of competitors is refreshed.
ftl_step6_b: Do not type the name in. A hand-typed name comes back to us as a new person and creates a duplicate in the ranking that cannot quietly be merged afterwards. Add them from our database instead: this download contains a FENCER DATABASE file for every weapon. Event Competitors → Import from XML (p. 145), choose the database file, tick that one person and click OK.
ftl_step7_b: If you publish the competition on Fencing Time Live there is nothing more to do — we collect the results from there ourselves. If it did not reach FTL, send us the results file exported from Fencing Time.
ftl_step8_h: A question, or something looks wrong
ftl_step8_b: Write to us before you start correcting names by hand — regenerating the files is almost always quicker.
ftl_contact_fallback: Reply to the message in which you received the link to this page.
